title: unitframes
summary: Program.UnitFrames.cs draws the player and target frames on the real mirrored UI-TargetingFrame art with correct recessed layering: portrait (live-baked or fallback), health/power bars with power-type colors, faction-tinted target name background, name + level text with difficulty color, high-level skull, DEAD text, combat flash, and the target's buff/debuff rows with dispel-tinted UI-Debuff-Overlays borders and stack counts (DrawTargetAuras). The file itself enumerates its absent elements for parity capture.

openItems.text: No PVP icons on player/target frames (Benilla's three-branch UpdatePvP law: Alliance/Horde/FFA) and no CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP anywhere (the registry's missing opcode; Benilla exposes it via /pvp)
No elite/rare/rareelite/worldboss classification border swap on the target frame (Benilla landed CheckClassification)
No rest icon/status glow on the player frame (Program.UnitFrames.cs lines 125-134 self-declare PlayerRestIcon, PlayerStatusGlow, PlayerAttackIcon etc. NOT-DRAWN)
No leader/master-looter icons and no group indicator plate
No right-click dropdown wired to the player/target frames themselves (the unit popup opens only from party frames and world-click)
